description: Crypto price API: BTC, ETH and SOL spot prices in USD in one GET, or one coin via symbol= (bad symbol: 400, no charge). Returns JSON: assets.BTC/ETH/SOL with priceUsd, change24hPct and momentum (bullish/bearish/neutral), plus overall momentum, sentiment (risk-on/risk-off/neutral), direction (up/down/flat), avgChange24hPct and asOf. Prices from Coinbase Exchange with CoinGecko fallback (source field). Labels are fixed rules on 24h change, not advice. Errors are not charged. Price $0.002 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Data changes about every 1 min; calling more often returns the same values.
name: pulse
